name: A ONE OFF DATE WITH A SOCK
source:
Go on a one-off date with a sock who you only met like about six hours ago because I say so, it doesn't matter if you have no memories of the previous events of your life before waking up in a middle of a park- you still are going to marry that sock.

[From [url=https://braided-adventures.itch.io/a-one-off-date-with-a-sock]Itch.io[/url]]
